'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Micah Wall LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Micah Wall]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
